title: Step 1 - One-Hot Encoding: Transforming Categorical Features for ML Algorithms

cues.en: Instructor: All right, my friends, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，我們繼續。

cues.en: Let's proceed to the next tool in our data pre-processing toolkit which is about encoding categorical data.
cues.zh: 接下來的資料前處理工具，是類別資料編碼。

cues.en: So first let me explain why we have to do this.
cues.zh: 先說明為什麼需要它。

cues.en: Let's open the data set again.
cues.zh: 再次打開資料集。

cues.en: And as we can see, this data set contains one column with categories, you know, France, Spain, or Germany.
cues.zh: 可以看到，其中一欄包含 France、Spain、Germany 這些類別。

cues.en: First, you might guess that it'll be difficult for machine learning model to compute some correlations between these columns, you know, the features and the outcome,
cues.zh: 你可能猜得到，機器學習模型很難直接計算這些欄位，也就是特徵，與結果，

cues.en: which is the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 也就是依變數之間的關係。

cues.en: And therefore, of course we'll have to turn these strings, you know, these categories into numbers.
cues.zh: 所以必須先把這些字串、這些類別，轉成數字。

cues.en: So one idea would be to encode France into zero, Spain into one, and Germany into two.
cues.zh: 一種想法是，把 France 編碼為 0、Spain 為 1、Germany 為 2。

cues.en: However, if we do this, our future machinery model could understand that because France is zero, Spain is one, and Germany is two, there is a numerical order between these three countries
cues.zh: 但如果這樣做，模型可能會認為，因為 France 是 0、Spain 是 1、Germany 是 2，這三個國家有數值上的順序，

cues.en: and mostly it could interpret that this order matters whereas of course it is absolutely not the case, right?
cues.zh: 更重要的是，可能認為這個順序有意義，但事實完全不是如此。

cues.en: There is not a relationship order between these three countries, France, Germany, and Spain.
cues.zh: France、Germany、Spain 之間，並沒有這種順序關係。

cues.en: So we want to avoid the model to have such an interpretation because that could cause some misinterpreted correlations between the features and the outcome
cues.zh: 我們要避免模型產生這種解讀，否則可能誤判特徵與

cues.en: which we want to predict.
cues.zh: 目標結果之間的關聯。

cues.en: Therefore, we can actually do much better than just encode these three countries into zero, one, and two.
cues.zh: 因此，可以採用比直接編成 0、1、2 更好的方式。

cues.en: And this thing that we can do better is actually one hot encoding and one hot encoding consists of turning this country column
cues.zh: 這個方式就是獨熱編碼，也就是把 Country 這一欄，

cues.en: into three columns.
cues.zh: 轉換成三個欄位。

cues.en: Why three columns?
cues.zh: 為什麼是三欄？

cues.en: Because there are actually three different classes in this country column, you know, three different categories.
cues.zh: 因為 Country 欄位剛好有三種不同類別。

cues.en: If there were, for example, five countries here, we would turn this column into five columns.
cues.zh: 如果有五個國家，就會轉換成五個欄位。

cues.en: And one hot encoding consists of creating binary vectors for each of the countries.
cues.zh: 獨熱編碼會替每個國家建立一個二元向量。

cues.en: Let me explain this right away.
cues.zh: 我馬上說明。

cues.en: So very simply, France would, for example have the vector 1 0 0.
cues.zh: 例如，France 可以表示為向量 [1, 0, 0]。

cues.en: Spain would have the vector 0 1 0 and Germany would have the vector 0 0 1.
cues.zh: Spain 表示為 [0, 1, 0]，Germany 則是 [0, 0, 1]。

cues.en: So that then there is not a numerical order between the three countries because instead of having zero, one, and two, we would only have zeros and ones.
cues.zh: 這樣三個國家之間就沒有數值順序，因為不再用 0、1、2，而是只使用 0 與 1。

cues.en: And therefore, three new columns.
cues.zh: 因此，會新增三個欄位。

cues.en: I'm gonna show you, of course, what we're gonna create.
cues.zh: 稍後當然會示範建立出來的結果。

cues.en: We're basically going to replace this country column by three new columns containing the zeros and ones and coding each of the countries.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是用三個包含 0 與 1 的欄位，替換 Country 欄位，分別編碼每個國家。

cues.en: That is called one hot encoding and that is a very useful and popular method to use when pre-processing your data sets containing categorical variables.
cues.zh: 這叫做獨熱編碼，是前處理類別變數資料集時，非常實用且常見的方法。

cues.en: So that's the first thing we'll do here for this country column.
cues.zh: 這是針對 Country 欄位要做的第一件事。

cues.en: And then, remember that there is also this purchased columns that has labels, you know, non-numerical values with yes and nos.
cues.zh: 另外，Purchased 欄位也有 Yes 與 No 這些非數值標籤。

cues.en: And we will actually have to replace them by zeros and ones.
cues.zh: 我們必須把它們替換為 0 和 1。

cues.en: And that's totally fine for the dependent variable as long as it is a binary outcome, it is super fine.
cues.zh: 這對依變數來說沒有問題，只要結果是二元的就可以。

cues.en: It will actually not compromise the future accuracy of the model if you just replace no and yes by zero and one.
cues.zh: 單純把 No 與 Yes 換成 0 與 1，不會因此損害模型未來的準確率。

cues.en: Okay, so I will teach you how to do these two things.
cues.zh: 我會教你完成這兩件事。

cues.en: And first, let's start by one hot encoding the country column here.
cues.zh: 首先，對 Country 欄位做獨熱編碼。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's create a new code cell for this new step and coding the independent variable.
cues.zh: 建立新的程式儲存格，進行自變數編碼這個步驟。

cues.en: All right, so to do this, we're going to use two classes.
cues.zh: 這裡要用兩個類別。

cues.en: The first one is the column transformer class from the compose module of once again the scikit-learn library.
cues.zh: 第一個是 scikit-learn 的 compose 模組中的 ColumnTransformer。

cues.en: And the second class is the one hot encoded class from the pre-processing module of the same Scikit-learn library.
cues.zh: 第二個是同一個函式庫 preprocessing 模組中的 OneHotEncoder。

cues.en: So first, let's import these two classes.
cues.zh: 先匯入這兩個類別。

cues.en: So we have to take them from Scikit-learn, from which we're gonna call first the compose module.
cues.zh: 從 sklearn 開始，先取得 compose 模組。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: From which we're going to import that class we're interested in, which is as Google Colab guesses perfectly, Columntransformer.
cues.zh: 從裡面匯入需要的類別，Google Colab 的提示很準確，就是 ColumnTransformer。

cues.en: And then from scikit-learn once again we're gonna get access to the pre-processing module, perfect, from which we're going to import
cues.zh: 再從 sklearn 取得 preprocessing 模組，從裡面匯入

cues.en: the one hot encoded class.
cues.zh: OneHotEncoder 類別。

cues.en: And now we're gonna mix these two classes in order to do this one hot encoding on the country column.
cues.zh: 接著結合這兩個類別，對 Country 欄位進行獨熱編碼。
